executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from collections import Counter
import copy,hashlib,json
root=Path.cwd();out=root/"reports/research/510300_actual_loan_allocation_full_original_source_v1"
def now():return datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def rel(p):return p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
def ref(p):return {"path":rel(p),"sha256":sha(p.read_bytes())}
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def save(name,x):
    p=out/name
    if p.exists():raise RuntimeError("同源原题修正产物已存在，禁止覆盖")
    p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,default=str)+"\n",encoding="utf-8");return ref(p)
source0=out/"全部29原季度完整原稿原量范围自己时钟及未知_E116.json"
joint0=out/"全部79原身份_投向量时间资格与完整经营共同背景_E116.json"
src=read(source0);rows=copy.deepcopy(src["rows"]);wrong=next(r for r in rows if r["quarter"]=="2021Q1")
raw=root/wrong["raw_source"]["path"];assert sha(raw.read_bytes())==wrong["raw_source"]["sha256"]
soup=BeautifulSoup(raw.read_bytes(),"html.parser")
native_title=soup.title.get_text(" ",strip=True)
assert native_title=="一季度末普惠小微贷款余额同比增长34.3%"
assert wrong["complete_original_article_text"].startswith("人民银行近日发布的2021年一季度金融机构贷款投向统计报告显示")
assert len(wrong["all_original_method_notes"])==1
save("同原新闻摘要误匹配识别与固定完整稿门修正认领_E116.json",{
 "at":now(),"revision":"V1.0.1_FULL_NATIVE_REPORT_TITLE_NOT_QUOTED_IN_NEWS",
 "failure":"初解析把正文开头引用的原报告名称当自己的全国完整原稿标题，误收2021Q1新闻摘要。",
 "fixed_preexisting_rule":"E116登记明确排除新闻摘录，仅同原全国完整投向稿。该摘要缺企业期限/用途与原方法注，不能被主要五余额字面存在替代。",
 "raw_native_title":native_title,"raw_response":ref(raw),"initial_29_and79_gate_outputs_preserved":True,
 "correction":"同一已取响应撤销其完整原稿身份与自己的原稿钟；数量、摘要自己的meta公开日期、原背景和失败保留，不另搜/另GET/另载体。",
 "new_requests":0,"new_financial_candidates":0,"new_model_fits":0})
before_wrong=copy.deepcopy(wrong)
wrong["retrieved_excerpt_own_publication_at"]=wrong["own_publication_at"]
wrong["retrieved_excerpt_native_title"]=native_title
wrong["native_title"]=native_title
wrong["quantity_qualified"]=False
wrong["original_year_quarter_identity_pass"]=False
wrong["own_publication_at"]="UNKNOWN"
wrong["own_clock_status"]="NEWS_EXCERPT_SELF_DATE_IS_NOT_FULL_ORIGINAL_REPORT_CLOCK"
wrong["unknowns"]=["固定选择/初解析把摘要正文引用的报告名称误当原全国完整稿；原摘要量留存，但完整原稿缺失，不换来源"]
wrong["full_source_rejection_reason"]="OFFICIAL_NEWS_ABRIDGEMENT_NOT_FULL_ORIGINAL"
assert wrong["loan_allocation_original_atoms"]==before_wrong["loan_allocation_original_atoms"]
assert wrong["complete_original_article_text"]==before_wrong["complete_original_article_text"]
for i,r in enumerate(rows):
    if r["quarter"]!="2021Q1":assert r==src["rows"][i]
src["rows"]=rows;src["parser_revision"]="V1.0.1";src["initial_artifact_preserved"]=ref(source0)
srcref=save("全部29原季度完整原稿原量范围自己时钟及未知_v1_0_1_E116.json",src)
oldjoint=read(joint0);joint=copy.deepcopy(oldjoint["rows"])
for row in joint:
    row["original_quarter_source"]=srcref
    if row["source_quarter"]=="2021Q1":
        row.update({"quarter_quantity_qualified":False,"own_publication_at":"UNKNOWN","own_clock_before_original_cutoff":False,
            "joint_quantity_and_own_clock_pass":False,"source_gate_status":"UNKNOWN_QUANTITY_OR_SCOPE",
            "loan_quantity_input_at_original_cutoff":None,"original_quantity_archival_only_if_not_known":True,
            "publication_age_days_at_original_cutoff":None,"source_rejection":"OFFICIAL_NEWS_ABRIDGEMENT_NOT_FULL_ORIGINAL"})
for i,r in enumerate(joint):
    assert r["fixed_original_identity"]==oldjoint["rows"][i]["fixed_original_identity"]
    assert r["old_current_operating_values_unchanged"]==oldjoint["rows"][i]["old_current_operating_values_unchanged"]
    assert r["complete_old_same_cutoff_price_funding_order_profit_collection_inventory_aged_fund_unchanged"]==oldjoint["rows"][i]["complete_old_same_cutoff_price_funding_order_profit_collection_inventory_aged_fund_unchanged"]
oldjoint["rows"]=joint;oldjoint["parser_revision"]="V1.0.1";oldjoint["initial_artifact_preserved"]=ref(joint0)
jointref=save("全部79原身份_投向量时间资格与完整经营共同背景_v1_0_1_E116.json",oldjoint)
passrows=[r for r in joint if r["joint_quantity_and_own_clock_pass"]]
years=[]
for year in sorted({r["fixed_original_identity"]["economic_period"][:4] for r in joint}):
    ys=[r for r in joint if r["fixed_original_identity"]["economic_period"].startswith(year)]
    good=[r for r in ys if r["joint_quantity_and_own_clock_pass"]]
    years.append({"year":year,"all_original_identities":len(ys),"quantity_clock_pass":len(good),"unknown":len(ys)-len(good),
      "original_joint_cells_all":dict(Counter(r["old_collection_inventory_joint_cell_unchanged"] for r in ys)),
      "original_joint_cells_if_source_qualified_descriptive_only":dict(Counter(r["old_collection_inventory_joint_cell_unchanged"] for r in good))})
co=[]
for r in passrows:
    a=next(x for x in r["loan_quantity_input_at_original_cutoff"] if x["kind"]=="工业中长期")
    co.append({"original_sequence_idx":r["fixed_original_identity"]["original_sequence_idx"],"economic_period":r["fixed_original_identity"]["economic_period"],
      "quarter":r["source_quarter"],"loan_yoy":a["reported_stock_yoy_pct"],"loan_balance_yi":a["balance_yi"],
      "old_values":r["old_current_operating_values_unchanged"],"old_joint_cell":r["old_collection_inventory_joint_cell_unchanged"],"source_age_days":r["publication_age_days_at_original_cutoff"]})
coexist={"at":now(),"all_years":years,"source_qualified_descriptive_rows":co,"full_original_denominator":79,
 "qualified_denominator_not_financial_training_pool":len(passrows),"unique_qualified_source_quarters":len({r["source_quarter"] for r in passrows}),
 "loan_positive_coexist_with_DSO_extension":sum(x["loan_yoy"] is not None and x["loan_yoy"]>0 and x["old_values"]["DSO_yoy_days"]>0 for x in co),
 "loan_positive_coexist_with_inventory_turnover_extension":sum(x["loan_yoy"] is not None and x["loan_yoy"]>0 and x["old_values"]["inventory_turnover_yoy_days"]>0 for x in co),
 "not_independent_events_or_causal_effects":True,"next_economic_or_stock_outcomes_not_used":True,"parser_revision":"V1.0.1"}
save("所有原身份分年覆盖与量义共同状态_不缩金融样本_v1_0_1_E116.json",coexist)
gate0=out/"source_gate.json";gate=read(gate0)
gate.update({"at":now(),"quantity_qualified_quarters":sum(r["quantity_qualified"] for r in rows),
 "quarters_with_own_publication_clock":sum(r["own_publication_at"]!="UNKNOWN" for r in rows),
 "quantity_and_own_clock_quarters":sum(r["quantity_qualified"] and r["own_publication_at"]!="UNKNOWN" for r in rows),
 "original79_quantity_clock_pass":len(passrows),"original79_gate_status_counts":dict(Counter(r["source_gate_status"] for r in joint)),
 "unknown_original_identities":[r["fixed_original_identity"] for r in joint if not r["joint_quantity_and_own_clock_pass"]],
 "all_original79_source_gate_pass":len(passrows)==79,"parser_revision":"V1.0.1","initial_gate_preserved":ref(gate0)})
save("source_gate_v1_0_1.json",gate)
save("同原摘要资格修正必要证据与原量背景不变_E116.json",{"at":now(),"raw_source_unchanged":ref(raw),
 "initial_sources":ref(source0),"canonical_sources":srcref,"initial_joint":ref(joint0),"canonical_joint":jointref,
 "only_2021Q1_original_report_admission_revoked_no_new_source":True,"all29_original_amounts_and_bodies_unchanged":True,
 "all79_original_identity_operating_values_complete_background_equal":True,"no_parameter_threshold_fee_window_or_model_rescue":True,
 "initial_source_gate37_then_canonical35_preserved":True,"new_requests":0,"new_financial_labels":0})
assert (gate["quantity_qualified_quarters"],gate["quarters_with_own_publication_clock"],len(passrows))==(27,19,35)
print(json.dumps({"正式版本":"V1.0.1","完整原量季度":27,"完整原稿自己钟季度":19,"原79量钟合格":35,
 "原79未知分类":gate["original79_gate_status_counts"],"融资增长与回收期延长":coexist["loan_positive_coexist_with_DSO_extension"],
 "融资增长与库存周转延长":coexist["loan_positive_coexist_with_inventory_turnover_extension"],
 "来源独立季度":coexist["unique_qualified_source_quarters"],"股市标签拟合账户":0,"全原门":False},ensure_ascii=False))
